items.html: *Now we shall explain the matter of the posterior of AVI that fell and broke, as well. First, we must explain the introduction of face-to-face and back-to-back. The thing is that the place of the shells and the external ones are the posterior of the Nukva of ZA, and there they cling. However, there is also some gripping to the posterior of ZA. Before God created man on earth, the shells had the power to suckle abundance from the Kedusha [holiness], as it is written, “And there was not a man to till the ground.” One of the works on the soil is mowing thorns from the vineyard, for which, practical commandments are needed. However, when ZAT were emanated, the lower Adam haRishon had not been created in the world. ZON emerged back-to-back for fear of the suckling of the external ones, since had they stood face-to-face, the shells would have had a place to cling to their gripping place to suckle, which are the posterior. This is because they could not suckle from the anterior, and therefore had to be adhered back-to-back so the external ones would not be able to suckle from there.
